rows.note: The 0.97197751743 and 0.996075 usages are set by the assumed 10 MPa scarf-shear screen, which caps face stress at 300.333333 MPa. That screen is not a measured beryllium scarf allowable. The laboratory 0.651468543105 usage is the same with the screen off, because the ideal weld is scored as parent face compression.

With the fixed reserve and systems removed, the largest face thickness at zero core is 0.000896786528723 m and the 255 MPa compression factor is 0.958217295476. Core mass or joint excess leaves less face thickness. No gamma or wrinkling value changes that face factor.
